headline: Microsoft and Siemens authors report additive-AI high-sigma verification of a bandgap design
fact: A Microsoft and Siemens DAC 2025 presentation reports additive-AI verification of a 17,000-device bandgap design to five sigma. For the presented case, the authors report 40.4× fewer simulations and 19.4× lower wall-clock time, from about six hours to 18 minutes. The result remains a bounded customer/vendor case and is not generalized to other designs.

sources.title: Accelerating Bandgap Reference High-Sigma Verification with Additive AI Technology
sources.summary: The official DAC 2025 record identifies Microsoft and Siemens authors and describes the 17,000-device, five-sigma bandgap case with reported simulation-count and wall-clock reductions.
